actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Hosted runs recorded from public GitHub job metadata (no artifacts downloaded); every run passed both jobs: 39514065746 (pull request #4, dc6757e), 39555849817, 39560354328 and 39619295311 (pull request #5 at 2c84769, a136841 and 7a9e757) and 39621867049 (main, 7a9e757). Main moved from 3793081 to 7a9e757, the commit run 39619295311 tested, pushed by the agent at the Director's instruction to push once CI finished. Main run 39621867049 closes the advisory failure of main run 39509517284.

The Director reviewed the UX backlog status and 100 screenshots of the current interface (every non-reference Storybook story in Paper and Ink, open states of dialogs, the sheet, the confirmation, the tooltip and the inspector at 1280 and 390 px, and the web app's foundation page), captured from main 7a9e757 in headless Chromium 153. The screenshots and capture script are review material in the ignored .local folder and are not committed. While capturing, the tile's inspect button was found to show 'Printing' while its accessible name is 'Inspect …' (WCAG 2.5.3); the D26 tile change removes it.

Decision register: D24 (the enhanced card inspector is built from scratch in this project's design; the original Inkspire inspector is only a reference), D25 (all card data from Ravensburger's official v3 catalog, never made-up cards; scope confirmed: interface, Storybook and inspector work including its browser tests; neutral placeholders only as the takedown fallback; engine and rules tests keep synthetic fixtures) and D26 (design approved as shown at this time, with one change: a card tile shows the card itself and its details belong to the inspector).

Current documents brought in line: the AGENTS.md fixture rule now limits synthetic fixtures to engine and rules tests; status lines in AGENTS.md and docs/README.md; a dated validation section with the hosted runs, the review and the Ravensburger API check; a dated fan-content policy note on card data and fixtures; the UX-01 backlog evidence; and the handoff.
